us-southwest-p1-colovore-rno01-opening-r.summary: Colovore's release dated 9 September 2026 says the company has officially opened the first liquid-cooled AI data center on its RNO01 campus in Sparks, Nevada, in the Reno metro area, celebrated with a ribbon cutting.
